records.text:
(a) Parks and Wildlife peace officers shall be empowered to conduct traffic stops on players seen or known to be engaged in activities defined under Title 7. These traffic stops shall be known as “Title 7 traffic stops”.
N/A
N/A
N/A

context.subtitle: SUBTITLE 3:

context.subchapter: SUBCHAPTER III. PARKS AND WILDLIFE PEACE OFFICERS

records.text:
(b) The primary purpose of Title 7 traffic stops shall be to conduct Title 7 inspections. However, it shall be permitted for Parks and Wildlife peace officers to ensure that: the driver of the vehicle they stopped has an active driver’s license; the driver of the vehicle has no warrants; and the vehicle is not stolen. If other criminal code or vehicle code violations are observed while conducting a Title 7 traffic stop, Parks and Wildlife peace officers may take appropriate law enforcement action.
